description: This file defines an Android Fragment class named NfcProvisioningFragment responsible for handling NFC provisioning logic. It manages user interface components for inputting provisioning parameters, creates NFC NDEF messages to send these parameters via NFC, and supports loading initial provisioning values. It integrates with Android's NFC and device policy APIs to facilitate NFC-based device setup.

classes.name: NfcProvisioningFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that provides UI and NFC provisioning logic, enabling users to input device setup parameters and transmit them via NFC to other devices.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes UI components and binds event handlers after the view is created.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Sets up NFC message callback and initializes provisioning values loader.

methods.name: createNdefMessage
methods.description: Creates an NFC NDEF message containing device provisioning parameters in MIME type format.

methods.name: onTextChanged
methods.description: Updates the internal provisioning values map when user edits input fields.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a loader to asynchronously load initial provisioning values.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Updates UI with loaded provisioning values.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Handles loader reset; no action required.
